meta.dataset: datasets/usgs_hivis_stage (USGS HIVIS images + NWIS gauge height 00065; US public domain)
meta.protocol: Per site, frames sorted by time. Reference frame = first frame. Calibration split = earliest 25% of frames; test = remaining 75%. Each method's waterline position along the strip is mapped to stage by a robust (Theil-Sen) 2-parameter line fitted on that method's own calibration-split outputs. Thresholds and estimator code are frozen from the synthetic train split.
meta.label: REAL held-out frames (later 75% of each site's time series)

NY_East_Branch_Delaware_River_at_Hancock.scene: close-up staff gauge on a concrete wall, numerals in feet (10-20 ft)

full_numeral_calibration.note: Pixel centres of the printed foot numerals read from the 2026-07-27 08:00 EDT frame; mark stage = numeral + datum offset (1 parameter, fitted on the calibration split).
